title: La calle que no acaba · Nuria and Uri's mission
description: docs/quests/nuria.md § La calle que no acaba: Nuria tells them what Uri has been like since he woke, then, as they walk up from her door, houses rise out of the ground and shut every way but on until the corner unrolls into La calle with no cut: her street, past her block, runs one way only, straight on: her house again and again with a 1 on every door, the houses growing and the street narrowing, the colour draining to the Queen's violet and the screen's edges closing in, Aitor noticing it over his head, and at the far end the bubble that leads into Uri's fears.

steps.caption: Nuria at her door: Uri woke up talking and has not stopped
«Vamos a jugar a que no volvemos»: what Uri said as he took Nil
Walking up from her door: a house is born across the street behind them, where the way to the station was
Her house again, with a 1 on the door, where the crossing was
Another rises in the gardens on the right, dust and the ground shuddering
Both sides of Doctor Daurella close: no corner, no side street
Every way but on is shut
The corner unrolls: what stood beyond it sinks and the street stretches out over it
Its houses are born one after another, away from them
«Aquí había una esquina. Doctor Daurella.» «Ya no. Solo calle.»
Her street goes on, straight: La calle's own start laid over it
Well inside, still on her street's map
A step on, in La calle itself: the same spot, nothing jumps
A quarter up: the same house again and again, a 1 on every door
Halfway: the colour drains, the edges close in, Aitor notices it
Further up: taller houses, a narrower street, the Queen's violet; the edges start to beat
The bubble at the end: «por dentro está oscura»
The bubble portal into Uri's fears: walking up to it goes through
Through the bubble: «Esto ya no es Cardedeu»
